# Spray Foam Bank

> Not a bank or lender — a resource hub (used the way "food bank" uses the word) for the real cost, federal tax credit, rebates, and financing options for spray foam insulation. Includes an interactive cost calculator. Backed by Contractors Choice Agency's 20+ years of contractor experience. Content is not financial or tax advice.
